competitorWins: ACLED is genuinely stronger as the gold-standard research dataset for political violence: disaggregated event data (dates, actors, locations, fatalities, event types) across 200 countries and territories, a weekly conflict index, and focused monitors for Ukraine, Gaza, Yemen, and more. It is built for researchers, policymakers, and humanitarians doing rigorous analysis — a different job from WorldEye's consumer live globe. The two complement each other: ACLED supplies the structured evidence, WorldEye supplies the live picture.
description: ACLED (Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project) is a disaggregated data collection, analysis, and crisis-mapping project covering reported political violence and protest events in 200 countries and territories. It offers a public dashboard, downloadable datasets, a weekly conflict index, and focused conflict monitors — free for non-commercial use after registration, with broader API and organizational access tiered by level. It differs from WorldEye by being a research dataset and analysis project (not a live 3D globe), with no cameras, flight/ship tracking, or weather overlays, while WorldEye is a freemium live-planet platform.

verdictCompetitor: Choose ACLED if you're a researcher, journalist, or policymaker who needs rigorous, citable, disaggregated conflict-event data — and for non-commercial use it's free.
verdictWorldEye: Choose WorldEye if you want a free, no-signup live view of the planet — cameras, flights, ships, weather, quakes — with conflict context and Pro OSINT tools from $3.99/week.
whyWorldEye: ACLED requires registration and is a research dataset; WorldEye's map is free in your browser with no signup at all.
One free globe combines 74,229 live cameras with live flights, ships, satellites, weather, earthquakes, and wildfires — ACLED is event data, not a live picture.
Pro starts at $3.99/week: AI analyst assistant, OSINT recon toolkit (Nmap, DNS, WHOIS, SSL), premium cyber/GDELT/maritime/conflict intel feeds, and high-res satellite imagery.
Free live aircraft and maritime tracking with global search and advanced filters.
Interactive 3D globe and mobile-friendly design for anyone to explore — ACLED serves analysts, not casual monitoring.
Use them together: ACLED's structured event data is the research-grade complement to WorldEye's live situational view.
